scope: 公司网页测试图2/图3；多人领料与报工仅可行性评估

rootCauses.issue: partial issue looks like full issue while running
rootCauses.fact: IN_PROGRESS used active tone regardless of per-material issue facts; preparing view alone distinguished partial supply.

rootCauses.issue: 6000 output accepted with only 5000 kits issued
rootCauses.fact: Frozen material output capacity was explicitly treated only as a hint; exact actual consumption alone did not cap output. Query similarly used plan quantity. Ordinary actual-output allowance could bypass a UI-only cap.

sharedAuthority.contract: Reuse frozen fn_execution_material_output_capacity(TRUE), not current BOM. While below full issued plan capacity, subtract all nondeleted draft/approved ordinary output, including actual-surplus slices; exclude the report currently edited/approved. NULL means this additional partial-issue ceiling is inapplicable, zero means no room.
sharedAuthority.locks: Existing segment and active material-demand locks are acquired before a fresh capacity read; report create/edit/approve use the same guard. Pending returns/reversals use existing physical provenance/ledger authority.
limitations: The ceiling uses frozen planned consumption while issue is partial; it does not infer production yield from mutable current BOM or invent material use.
Reversal stays possible; already recorded historical output is not rewritten.

migratedCallers: DailyReportExecutionSegmentGuard.validateDraft: create and update, normalized output slices aggregated by execution segment
DailyReportExecutionSegmentGuard.approve: excludes current report and rechecks under the same locks
ReportablePlanLineQueryService: source picker/default quantity includes material room and exact text
ProductionDailyReportEditPage: pick source, fixed source metadata restore, local draft snapshot/restore, clear source, repeated save checks and cross-row material totals
DailyGridRow.clone/reset: material capacity survives copying and clears when identity changes
ProductionFlowStage.forSegment: one partial-running label/tone for workshop task table and task detail
ProductionFlowStageCell: violet existing tier, readable icon/text, status legend
ProductionExecutionSegmentsCard: plan detail and task detail statuses distinguish partial issue
ProductionWorkshopTaskStage: synchronous and durable report-export status text use shared fixture

platforms.web: Shared Flutter implementation changed; widget interactions tested, browser acceptance owned by root integration.
platforms.flutterDesktop: Same source changed; native actual UI/UAT not yet executed in this subtask.

wpfLegacy.note: These business pages are not yet migrated; no placeholder native write entry was added. Root should append evidence notes and regenerate source inventory once after integration.

personnelFeasibility.existing: Daily report already supports whole-report workerIds and production_daily_report_workers. These identify participants, not line contributions, piece-rate allocation or wages. Execution task has one responsible employee; draw header worker_id currently follows assignment and is not a per-event actual picker.
personnelFeasibility.difficulty: medium to high for a complete auditable chain; small for only a non-authoritative suggested participant list
personnelFeasibility.recommendedUniversalModel: Every real material issue event/batch can freeze one or more selected participant employee UUIDs, name snapshots and exact execution-segment/demand/ISSUE-posting references. Preserve maker, responsible employee and warehouse issuer separately. At report creation, suggest the union of participants from that task’s effective actual issue sources; explicit user confirmation is frozen on the report and the suggestion provenance is retained.
personnelFeasibility.generalization: Use one shared all-workshop capability with optional workshop policy; do not hard-code copper workshop name or infer payroll contribution from the A/B list.
requiredDecisions: Actual material picker versus production participant roles
Default all historical issue participants or only selected issue batches
Whether mixed-task reports require per-line participants
Whether and how quantities or wages are allocated; names alone do not establish shares
failureBoundaries: Issue reversal and return must retire source suggestions without rewriting past approved report snapshots
Shared/split material source batches need exact provenance, not employee-name matching
Employee departure, shift transfer and permissions must retain historical snapshots
Repeat requests/concurrent issue require idempotent participant facts and explicit version checks
personnelFeasibility.manualAdvice: Use existing report participant multi-selection A/B; record work-order number, issue occurrence and actual person A or B in draw remarks, retain issue documents. Do not overwrite work-order responsible employee merely to record the picker.
